objective: Correccion quirurgica del contrato de prueba shared-app previo al replay del Git Divergence Guard R2. Actualizar exclusivamente el test heredado que esperaba LOCAL_DIRTY_COLLISION_AUDIT_REQUIRED para que valide la nueva politica canonica de hard block GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN, preservando LOCAL_WORK_PRESERVATION_REQUIRED=YES y verificando que la semantica antigua ya no permanezca. No modificar implementacion, Worker, Supervisor, SQL, Production ni otros tests.

actions.old:
def test_dirty_app_is_observed_not_blanket_blocked():
    guard = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/shared_app_safety_guard.sh"
    text = guard.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "LOCAL_DIRTY_COLLISION_AUDIT_REQUIRED" in text
    assert "LOCAL_WORK_PRESERVATION_REQUIRED=YES" in text
    assert "DEFERRED_LOCAL_DIRTY" not in text
actions.new:
def test_dirty_app_is_hard_blocked_without_discarding_local_work():
    guard = ROOT / "tools/mirror_sync/shared_app_safety_guard.sh"
    text = guard.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "DECISION=GIT_WORKTREE_NOT_CLEAN" in text
    assert "LOCAL_WORK_PRESERVATION_REQUIRED=YES" in text
    assert "LOCAL_DIRTY_COLLISION_AUDIT_REQUIRED" not in text
    assert "DEFERRED_LOCAL_DIRTY" not in text
